name: 45° Side Bend
steps: Position yourself sideways on a hyperextension bench with your feet locked securely and the pad resting just below your bottom hip.
Cross your arms over your chest and line up your shoulders with your hips and legs.
Bend smoothly sideways toward the floor at the waist while keeping your chest facing straight forward.
Contract your top oblique to lift your torso back into line with your legs, then switch sides after finishing one side.
tips: Keep both hips stacked squarely against the pad rather than rotating forward or backward.
Stop rising once your torso forms a straight line with your legs instead of bending excessively upward.
